title: Bateman-Horn density predictions for primes of form 2^k*q+1

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in number theory: Bateman-Horn density predictions for primes of form 2^k*q+1.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Formalized BH density prediction for Erdos 1065 Form A primes. Proved safe prime equivalence, k-value census, BH implications. 1 sorry (uniqueness via 2-adic valuation) and 1 axiom (BH prediction itself).
builtItems: Created Proofs/Erdos1065BatemanHorn.lean (271 lines, 24 theorems, 1 axiom, 1 sorry)
Verified all 15 Form A primes <= 100 with their specific k values
insights: BH constant 2C2 is independent of k because 2^k is a unit mod every odd prime, so local root count is always 2
Safe primes are exactly the k=1 layer of Form A primes (proved as IsFormAWithK 1 p iff IsSafePrime p)
k-value distribution <= 100: k=0:1, k=1:7(safe primes), k=2:3, k=3:3, k=5:1. k=1 dominates at 47%
Decomposition uniqueness: (k,q) is unique for each Form A prime when q is odd, via 2-adic valuation
mathlibGaps: No direct 2-adic valuation of 2^k*q for odd q in Mathlib - need Nat.multiplicity
nextSteps: Prove formA_decomposition_unique: needs Nat.multiplicity or 2-adic valuation from Mathlib
Submit formA_decomposition_unique to Aristotle via companion file
Formalize the BH constant computation (infinite product) if Mathlib analysis improves
